name: DoorDash
note: Priced Dec 8, 2020 and opened at $182. First closed below its IPO price on Jan 26, 2022. Moved from NYSE to Nasdaq on Sep 27, 2023. Its record close came on Oct 6, 2025, the same day as Uber's.

name: Uber
note: Parent of Uber Eats, so the stock reflects rides and delivery together. Opened at $42 on day one.
events: Offers €41.50 a share for Delivery Hero

name: Instacart
note: Listed as Maplebear Inc. Opened at $42 on day one.

name: Grubhub
exit: Bought by Just Eat Takeaway.com in an all-stock deal (0.6710 JET ADS per share). Last traded Jun 14, 2021. Resold to Wonder in Jan 2025 for $650M.

name: Waitr
note: Went public by merging with the Landcadia Holdings SPAC ($10 reference price). Prices are per original share, adjusted for the 1-for-20 reverse split of Nov 2022.
exit: Delisted from Nasdaq Feb 2, 2023; filed for Chapter 7 liquidation Apr 2, 2024.

name: Deliveroo
note: Opened at 331p and closed at 287.45p on day one, the worst debut for a large London IPO on record. It closed at or above 390p on only two days, Aug 18 and Aug 24, 2021.
exit: Bought by DoorDash for 180p a share in cash (about £2.9bn). Last traded Oct 1, 2025.

name: Just Eat Takeaway
note: Listed as Takeaway.com at €23. The first day's close is not in the data; the series starts Oct 3, 2016.
exit: Bought by Prosus for €20.30 a share in cash (about €4.1bn). Last traded Nov 14, 2025.

name: Just Eat
exit: Absorbed by Takeaway.com in an all-share deal (0.12111 Takeaway.com shares per share), unconditional Jan 31, 2020. Last traded Feb 28, 2020.

name: Delivery Hero
note: Uber has offered €41.50 a share in cash; the acceptance period runs to Nov 5, 2026.

name: Talabat
note: Majority-owned by Delivery Hero. Largest tech IPO of 2024 (about $2bn raised). Closed at or above AED 1.60 on 10 days, all in Jan and Feb 2025.

name: Dada Nexus
note: Chinese on-demand delivery platform (JD NOW, Dada NOW) listed in New York; prices are per ADS.
exit: Taken private by JD.com at $2.00 per ADS in cash. Last traded Jun 16, 2025.

name: Zomato (Eternal)
note: Zomato Ltd renamed itself Eternal Ltd; the ticker changed from ZOMATO to ETERNAL on Apr 9, 2025.

name: Grab
note: Went public by merging with Altimeter Growth Corp. ($10 reference price). Ride-hailing plus GrabFood delivery across Southeast Asia. It has never closed at or above $10.
